method: Fresh Chrome per run; one game at a time; before1, after1, after2, before2, before3, after3. 32 renders per scene, discard first 8, median of 24 samples, then median of 3 runs. Desktop IBL enabled; render + gl.finish, not whole-game FPS. Fixed seed per version; flower heights and blossom counts can differ between versions because object creation changed.
